overview_description.description:
Dian Xiaomi is a e-commerce IT service company, focusing on providing SaaS system services for global e-commerce sellers, making it easier to "buy and sell globally".

Dian Xiaomi gathers a strong domestic IT R&D team. The core members are from well-known companies such as Baidu, Tencent, and Meituan. They have 15+ years of experience in software research and development.

Dian Xiaomi was established on March 26, 2014 by Jianyin Du in Longgang, Guangdong.

about_short_description.short_description: Dian Xiaomi provides one-stop services for global e-commerce sellers.

product.name: Dian Xiaomi ERP (店小秘ERP)
product.description: A free ERP platform for cross-border e-commerce sellers integrating over 70 major global e-commerce platforms to manage product listing, order processing, procurement, logistics, warehouse, and financial data.

product.name: Product Listing and Data Migration
product.description: Tools for efficient product data collection, migration, and multi-platform listing to speed up product publishing across e-commerce channels.

product.name: Order Management and Processing
product.description: Automated order processing system supporting multiple rules and barcode scanning for efficient order fulfillment and shipping label printing.

product.name: Procurement and Inventory Management
product.description: Intelligent procurement suggestions, replenishment strategies, and real-time inventory synchronization to optimize supply chain and stock levels.

product.name: Logistics and Warehouse Management
product.description: Integration with over 1700 logistics providers and 130 overseas warehouses for shipping label printing, tracking, and warehouse operations management.

product.name: Customer Service Management
product.description: Unified management of customer messages from platform inboxes and emails with automated reply rules and blacklist support.
